diagnosis: restCall (WorkFlowEngine, location=Application) does NOT wrap its response the way Adapter-location tasks do. Adapter tasks always return {response, headers, metrics} on their `result` outgoing variable (per SKILL.md 'query' section, line ~1300). restCall is a plain WorkFlowEngine utility task, not an Adapter task, so that wrapper does not apply to it -- its outgoing variable already holds the parsed JSON body of the HTTP response. Querying 'response.access_token' looks one level too deep, so it resolves to undefined/null every time, even though the restCall task itself succeeded (a 200 from Azure AD).
notes: 'a1b2' is the placeholder task ID for the restCall task -- substitute your real task ID and outgoing variable name.
The `obj` reference stays $var.a1b2.response (or whatever restCall's declared outgoing variable name is) -- only the `query` path changes, from 'response.access_token' to 'access_token'.

This is the mandatory verification step per SKILL.md Guide 2b ('Inspect the actual response before wiring a query path'): after a successful test run, GET /operations-manager/jobs/{jobId} and read data.tasks['<restCall task id>'].variables.outgoing (or the equivalent field showing resolved outgoing values) to see the real shape before trusting any assumed path. No live platform was available in this session to pull that job JSON, so this fix should be confirmed against an actual test run before being treated as final.

If restCall's outgoing variable is not literally named 'response' in your build (check task-schemas.json / multipleTaskDetails for the exact outgoing key), substitute accordingly -- the wrapper issue (no nested response/result envelope) is the same regardless of the variable's name.
